_readme: Sample answer file for the interactive tasks in fdr-failback-plan.json, consumed via Import-VCFIRAnswerFile.

Provide one ordered answer set per invocation of each cmdlet. The plan retrieves and restores VCFMS and VCF Automation backups, in that order. It updates VIPs for Identity Broker, Log Management and VCF Automation, in that order.
The power-off, cluster-entry removal, restore and VIP tasks each take one Y/N confirmation.

Start-ServicesRuntimeVMs uses one answer set per invocation, first for VCFMS and then for VCF Automation. Each step prompts for Y/N only when a matching VM is offline. Remove the key to confirm power-on at the console.
Each answer set is an ordered array of the values you would otherwise type at that cmdlet's Read-Host prompts, in the same order the prompts appear.
Get-BackupsFromSFTPServer uses group 1 and Y to build the restore JSON. If you choose custom group 0 when offered, supply one backup point ID per component in the order prompted before the final Y/N.

Run each task interactively first to verify the prompt order and discovered IDs. Omit a cmdlet key to answer at the console. For cmdlet answer sets, running out of values or supplying a value rejected by the cmdlet fails the run.
Confirm-ManualStep is a flat list of pre-approved AnswerKey strings. Keep a key only if the work at that gate will be complete before the plan reaches it. Remove a key to wait for Enter at that gate.
